url.description: Target of raw Patterns-Gallery html page.

description: Please be aware that the SVG patterns tool is configured to use **svg-patterns**, and the resulting file will be written to **build/patterns.js** relative to the current working directory. The raw HTML source for the pattern gallery is fetched from **https://gitcdn.xyz/repo/progers/Patterns-Gallery/master/index.html**. For reference, the configuration adheres to the definition found at **http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#**.
